SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating IN (4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mediumCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rating IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as badCount FROM review WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time) ASC
